findings.title: Seeing the Fire closes the search for support or escape
findings.claim: The negated finding clause can carry a wider relation in which seeing the Fire turns the criminals' search for any viable support or route away into a fixed encounter.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier يَجِدُوا at 18:53:8:1 carries finding and access to what is sought. The independent judgment scenes at 71:25 and 4:121 return through the same failed-access relation: helpers and a way of escape cannot be found. That contact changes the focus from a bare report of no direction into the collapse of the search topology after sight.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why seeing and failing to find belong together: recognition arrives with the loss of mobility, support, and an available way away.
findings.containment: The ordinary spatial reading of finding no way away remains intact. The wider relation does not make every occurrence of و ج د an escape term, and it does not claim that the focus narrates the wider ayahs. The supplied 4:110 connection keeps a pre-judgment route through repentance visible as a separate boundary.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch and carrier are supplied by a citable trusted finding, while the wider connections supply exact target Arabic but no target morphology; the relation is therefore retained with its scope qualified.

branch_activations.carrier: The negated imperfect finding form carries the search for an accessible object, means, or support.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied 71:25 and 4:121 judgment scenes describe failure to find a helper or an escape route.
branch_activations.activation: Those independent no-rescue scenes contact the focus finding verb through the same missing-access relation, so the failed finding becomes the collapse of available support after the Fire is seen.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The criminals do not merely lack a direction in the scene; their search for any viable support or way away has become unable to reach an answer.
branch_activations.boundary: This deepens the ordinary no-escape reading without turning every w-j-d occurrence into an escape expression or importing the full target scenes into the focus.

findings.title: The final missing maṣrif closes earlier redirections
findings.claim: The missing maṣrif can carry the wider relation that earlier turnings and changes of direction remain available while response is open, whereas the Fire scene closes the possibility of redirecting the course.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier مَصْرِفًا at 18:53:10:1 names a place or means of turning away. The independent connections at 7:47 and 3:152 supply actual turning operations, and 46:29 supplies a directed change toward hearing and warning. Their contact with the focus noun turns absence of a maṣrif into closure of the wider field of reorientation, not only absence of a physical exit.
findings.reader_payoff: The last clause becomes the endpoint of a history of possible turns: the force lies in the disappearance of redirection itself at the encounter.
findings.containment: The focus still says that no way away is found. B001 and B002 retain turning and repeated variation without activating the other available ṣ-r-f branches, and they do not assert that 18:54 is grammatically inside this ayah. The 4:110 connection preserves repentance as a pre-judgment alternative rather than a contradiction of the scene's final closure.

epistemic.reason: A citable trusted finding supplies both nominated focus branches and the anchored maṣrif carrier; the wider target connections have exact Arabic but incomplete target morphology, so the synthesis remains qualified.

branch_activations.boundary: The relation concerns turning direction and its closure here; it does not activate exchange, adornment, or every other ṣ-r-f usage.

branch_activations.boundary: This retains the branch's core of repeated change without claiming that every varied-state use is active or that the focus itself reports the wider response sequence.

findings.title: The seen Fire is also an explicit presentation
findings.claim: The focus's direct sight of the Fire can also be heard as the moment when the destination is made present before those who face it.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier رَءَا at 18:53:1:2 carries direct visual perception. The same-surah connection to 18:100 supplies a scene in which Hell is displayed before the disbelievers, so the seeing word returns through an act of presentation as well as perception.
findings.reader_payoff: The Fire is newly perceptible as being brought before the criminals, making recognition arrive through exposed presence rather than through an inward guess alone.
findings.containment: The ordinary report that the criminals see the Fire remains intact. This is a qualified same-surah resonance from a legacy retrospective and a connection whose target morphology is not supplied; it does not place 18:100 inside the grammar of 18:53 or claim a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective support is legacy_unbound, while the packet supplies exact target Arabic for the same-surah display connection but no target morphology; the presentation reading is therefore retained with explicit qualification.
